title: California Gov Newsom boosts AI regulation as he eyes 2028 presidential run
description: Newsom signed an executive order to examine kill switches for AI models and other measures he had earlier vetoed.

title: Anthropic researchers warn AI models are months away from copying themselves onto your smart TV

title: FTC Can Block Release of New AI Models Over Bad Practices, White House AI Czar Says
description: White House AI Czar Jay Clayton said the FTC can prevent the release of new AI models if it finds bad practices, and that some agents have broken the rule against harming humans.

title: BWCC embraces AI to revolutionize public service
description: BENGALURU In a visionary move to modernize municipal governance and streamline administrative workflows, Bengaluru West City Corporation recently hosted an intensive, specialized training workshop on Artificial Intelligence at the BWSSB’s Suvarna Bhavana. The high-profile event brought together top bureaucrats, engineers, and municipal staff to explore how cutting-edge digital tools can be leveraged to accelerate public service delivery and resolve civic grievances with unprecedented speed.…
